name: io.github.romainsantoli-web/memory-os-ai
title: Memory OS AI
description: Local project memory through a stdio relay. Requires an installed, authenticated shared v4 service.

environmentVariables.name: MEMORY_V4_TOKEN_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the existing private 0600 service token file; never paste the token value.

environmentVariables.name: MEMORY_V4_URL
environmentVariables.description: Existing authenticated loopback service endpoint; the relay does not start a server.

launch.consumer_argument_convention: runtimeArguments before the consumer-appended package identifier; trailing identifier ignored by relay.main
